title: E: Meridian Business Bank (companies). A clean specification of 56 rules
stresses: identity: company registration number with leading zeros and year founded
a tool API that does not say how many tries are left, and answers `success` instead of `ok`
Saturday is a business day; holidays on Saturdays
a calendar-day deadline, a month-end deadline, a band with no persuasion attempt
an offer of half the amount
attempts counted for the whole call
a refused facility gets no note
no retry when a promise fails
a callback the contact asks for
a date after the deadline is refused, not replaced
`local_time` with a space, not a T
